en: A vintage sepia-toned street view showing a grand multi-storey hotel building with balconies and ornate rooflines on the left, identified as 'Wettiner Hof'. The ground floor has shops and arcades; several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the broad, tree‑lined street. Large leafy trees line the right side of the scene. The printed title at the top reads 'Bad Elster — Wettiner Hof'.
